A different kind of new

A fictional studio concept celebrating the beauty of repair.

The best pieces have lived a little.

A scuffed arm, a faded finish, a wobbly leg. These are signs of a life well lived, not reasons to start over. We believe in caring for the things that have cared for us.

Our approach is simple: understand the piece, respect its history, and make it ready for whatever comes next.

What does your piece need?

A little more support

Loose joints may need careful assessment, cleaning and re-gluing. Avoid forcing the frame or adding screws before a craftsperson takes a look.
